name: Critical thinking measure (draft)
purpose: Share of requests with a named problem, ideal and metric.
record: Share of requests with a named problem, ideal and metric. Draft: no cases or runs exist yet.
disadvantages: It counts requests that name a problem, an ideal and a metric, so it can reward naming all three without the naming being apt.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=requests with known answers through a fake model] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > staged [sample=sample | real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=a call budget is set and the spend is approved] > whole [sample=full | real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=the staged sample did not decide]
